title: Noise stability as a quadrant probability
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, let $t\in\mathbb R$, and let $n$ be a nonnegative integer. The probability that both coordinates of the normalized sum of $n$ independent correlated sign pairs exceed $t$ equals the noise stability at correlation $\rho$ of the indicator that a normalized sum of $n$ independent uniform signs exceeds $t$.
caveat: The measure and noise stability are definitional objects whose full constructions are not provided in the supplied informal definitions; the sentence summarizes their formulas as encoded by the Lean definitions.
